title: Revolutioner
summary: REVOLU'TIONER, noun 1. One who is engaged in effecting a revolution; a revolutionist. 2. In England, one who favored the revolution in 1688.

inlines.v: REVOLU'TIONER, noun 1. One who is engaged in effecting a revolution; a revolutionist. 2. In England, one who favored the revolution in 1688.
